body.heading: Where in the world is Maldives?
paragraphs: Maldives is a country in Southern Asia, which is part of Asia. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Maldives is Malé.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Maldives is Divehi.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Maldives is the Maldivian rufiyaa.

body.heading: How big is Maldives?
paragraphs: Maldives covers about 300 square kilometres of land and inland water. It is the smallest country in Asia.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Maldives is a necklace of coral atolls. Families snorkel straight off the beach with turtles, rays and rainbow fish in water as clear as glass.
Malé is one of the world's smallest, liveliest capitals — fish markets, the golden-domed Islamic Centre and local cafés packed onto one small island.
